name: omacom/fantasi
title: Omarchy's next update installs Fantasi, a local image, short video clip and song maker with no cloud
summary: Fantasi is MIT-licensed and installed by default in the next Omarchy release: text-to-image, instruction edits, image-to-clip with sound (2, 5 or 10 s, memory permitting) and lyrics-to-song, all on local models. The post shows a 33 s demo; no model names or speeds are given.
